links.outcome: Accuracy and potentially harmful wrong answers of LLMs on glaucoma multiple-choice questions
links.effect: AAO ONE accuracy: DeepSeek-V3.2 69.0%, GPT-5.2 93.0%, Gemini 3 Pro 92.2%, Claude Opus 4.5 96.1%. Four potentially harmful wrong answers (HW2) occurred across 161 questions, with no significant difference across models.
links.quote: Harmful errors were uncommon but present, underscoring the need for clinician oversight.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the accuracy and potential harm of several LLMs on glaucoma multiple-choice questions without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
